# PSI-007: add a Husky pre-commit hook so bun run agent:check runs on every commit and rejects commits with an invalid history entry or stale .hermes.md.

%% generated by scripts/obsidian-sync.ts: edit the sources, not this file %%

**Tasks:** [[tasks/PSI-007|PSI-007]] · **Agent:** hermes (omniroute:combo-cheaper-inference-prio) · **Operator:** ficana · **Outcome:** done

**Session:** 2026-09-25 13:10 WIB → 2026-09-25 13:30 WIB · branch `master`

**Human review:** required: Operator ficana verified the hook rejects invalid history entries and passes on clean state; PSI-006 gate functioning as acceptance criteria states.

## Summary

Added husky@9.1.7 as a dev dependency (bun add -d husky), initialized .husky/ via bunx husky init, replaced the default pre-commit ('bun test') with 'bun run agent:check', and set core.hooksPath=.husky. The hook file needs an #!/usr/bin/env sh shebang on Windows/Git-for-Windows to be spawnable. Verified the reject path: an intentionally invalid history entry (missing human_review and empty verification) made agent:check exit 1 with 7 schema errors and blocked the commit; after removing it, the hook passes on a clean commit (exit 0). The pre-commit also blocks stale .hermes.md (agent:context --check). PSI-006's scripts were already present, so only the hook wiring was added.

## Decisions

- **Use husky@9.x with core.hooksPath=.husky**: Husky 9 manages hooks via a versioned .husky/ dir without the shell-wrapper footguns of older versions; husky init sets core.hooksPath and the prepare script installs hooks on bun install (alternatives: Manual .git/hooks/pre-commit script (no prepare/bootstrap, lost on clone); lint-staged (overkill — acceptance only needs agent:check))
- **pre-commit runs the full bun run agent:check (sync --check && context --check)**: Exactly matches the accept line; catches invalid history entries AND stale .hermes.md in one gate (alternatives: Only obsidian-sync --check (misses stale .hermes.md); Separate lint step (out of scope for PSI-007))
- **Add #!/usr/bin/env sh shebang to .husky/pre-commit**: Git-for-Windows cannot spawn a shebang-less hook via core.hooksPath (error: cannot spawn .husky/pre-commit: No such file or directory); husky's generated file had no shebang on this system (alternatives: Rely on husky's internal shim (broke on Windows); Use cmd wrapper (platform-specific))
